module: "Race Test" window of the race editor: lets you try the race being edited. It creates a gameplay/race/race object from the current path (debug draw enabled), offers lap count, teleporting the vehicle to a start position, normal or rolling start (Start / Start Rolling, which disables the editor), AI driving tests (current vehicle or all), then displays times and an event log. State machine: setup, race, stopped. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/raceEditor/testing')(raceEditor).
notes: C:draw is only called when the window is open (editor_raceEditor.onUpdate); in "race" state, it calls race:onUpdate(dt) every frame.
"AI Drive Test All Vehicles" only keeps vehicles within 100 m (squared distance ≤ 10000) of the default start position, if it exists; otherwise all vehicles.
The AI is started with startAiVehicle(id, 0.8).
The functions drawSetup, drawRace, drawStopped use self.race: setupRace must have been called before draw, otherwise self.race is nil.

C.desc: Race test window (windowDescription = 'General'). Instantiated with init(raceEditor). Fields: race (gameplay/race/race object), state ('setup', 'race' or 'stopped'), path.

init.desc: Stores raceEditor, startIndex = -1 and the 'setup' state.

setPath.desc: Sets the race path to test.

setupRace.desc: Creates a new race object for the path (keeping the previous lap count, otherwise 1), enables useDebugDraw, assigns the player vehicle and switches to the 'setup' state.

startRace.desc: Starts the race: applies config.rollingStart to the path, assigns the vehicles, calls race:startRace(), switches to the 'race' state and, if enableAi, starts the AI on each vehicle (relative speed 0.8).

vehIds.desc: Vehicle IDs; by default the player vehicle (be:getPlayerVehicleID(0)).

enableAi.desc: true to have the AI drive the vehicles.

draw.desc: Draws the UI according to the state (setup, race with race update, stopped).

drawSetup.desc: Setup UI: lap count, "Move to <start>" buttons, Start, Start Rolling, move all vehicles to the start positions, AI tests.

drawRace.desc: In-race UI: Stop button (aborts the race for all vehicles and reopens the editor), State (state dump), Recover (requestRecover), then times and log.

drawStopped.desc: After-stop UI: Restart button (back to setup), times and log.

drawTimes.desc: Displays the first vehicle's times via race:inDrawTimes; a click toggles the detailed display.

drawEventLog.desc: Displays the first vehicle's event log via race:inDrawEventlog.
